summary: No held thesis was broken by news today. The tape was quiet for the book: the held names drew no adverse company-specific headlines or filings, and the only live items were IDXX (second UBS PT cut, now exactly 5 trading days from its estimated 11-02 print) and the unresolved INCY date. Applying L2, the 8-K 2.02/10-Q filings in the input resolved the date for the names that reported: GRMN (10-28), RRC (8-K 2.02 10-28, 10-Q 10-27, on top of the EQT deal), DORM and EXLS and LOGI (10-26/27). INCY is the exception: its 10-27 estimate passed with no 8-K 2.02, no results headline and no 10-Q, only a Genmab/Adagene pipeline item, so the print most likely has not happened. That supports the PM's rejection of P2 for event-risk reasons, though it is an inference from absent filings, not a confirmed date. Crypto news was commentary and positioning (Gensler/Warren anecdote, Bessent digital-asset speech, $76k/$82k Fed-day levels); no exchange failure or adverse regulation, so the BTC thesis condition on news holds. BND (bought today) and IEF face the Fed decision with no bond-specific headline. My earlier news calls remain weak (4 right, 12 wrong, 69 pending): most estimated-date 'high risk' flags did not produce moves, which argues for weighting verified filings over the date estimate.
upcoming: INCY: estimated 10-27 date passed with no 8-K 2.02; watch for the results release and treat the unverified date as live risk. IDXX: estimated 11-02, 5 trading days out (the 10-20 thesis said outside the window; it is now at the edge). UBS cut its PT to $627 from $670 on 10-27, following Jefferies' $705 on 10-20, a second PT cut; ratings are unchanged (UBS Neutral), so not a break, but a third cut or a rating change before the print would matter. 10-29 estimated prints: AAPL (Benzinga cites 11-02; either way inside the window, with a touchscreen MacBook Pro event on 10-28), HWM, LNG, BDC, BJRI; none are held. Fed decision today (10-28) is the dominant risk for BND, IEF, VOO, VTI and BTC; the PM already ruled no further bond adds before a post-Fed reassessment. Microsoft and Alphabet report after the close, a QQQ/VOO/VTI read-through for the broad-market sleeve. DPZ: no news since DA Davidson's 10-26 PT cut to $382 (Buy kept); invalidation of $274.88 is still anchored to the pre-fill reference close and sits about 13% below the $316.58 fill (L1), so it needs re-anchoring. KR and WMT: estimated 12-03 and 11-19, outside the window. WMT's 10-23 8-K item 8.01 remains unread (only item numbers are visible to me, L2 open item); today's WMT headlines (Affirm exclusive BNPL at Sam's Club, clinical trial centers) are constructive and minor. CART: the 8-K item 2.05 (exit or disposal costs) filed 10-26 is new, and the DoorDash-Instacart $17B deal talk is reported, not confirmed; CART is not held. DBX (not held): 8-K 2.02/2.05/5.02 filed today with a ~9% headcount cut and guidance in line or above; the 5.02 item has no detail in my input. SMG (not held): estimated 11-04; the 10-16 8-K 5.02 is still unread. CALX and CVS: estimated 10-28 prints with no 8-K 2.02 in the input yet.
